cells.gaps: No source since October 2023 says refugees or displaced people may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID. In 2026 identity card issue in the Savanes was stalled for lack of materials.
cells.note: Stage 3: CNAR produced and distributed 10,972 refugee identity cards in the Savanes in 2025, and registration went on in 2026 though card issue stalled. Nothing says refugees may use SIM cards, accounts or digital ID, so not 4.
